$comment: Machine-readable contract for a finalized bundle claims.json (spec 010, FR-014 and C-REL-24). Every object is strict (additionalProperties: false). The offline verifier tests each claim's refusalSite for liveness and rejects a safeWording/honestyLevel that overstates the evidence (exit 21).
title: Living Roots Claims Register
description: Claim -> evidence pointers produced by the single ManifestBuilder producer alongside manifest.json. Draft 2020-12, strict objects, immutable versioned $id.

schemaVersion.title: Claims schema version
schemaVersion.description: Payload version. v1 is the first published claims schema and is immutable; any breaking change requires a new vN file and a new $id.

runId.title: Run ID
runId.description: Must equal the runId recorded in the bundle's manifest.json and the evidence-bundle-<runId>/ directory component.

honestyLevel.title: Bundle honesty level
honestyLevel.description: Highest honesty level claimed for this bundle. Every claim's honestyLevel MUST NOT exceed it.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: Bounded claims, each pointing at evidence in the same bundle. An empty list is legal only when the bundle claims nothing.

honestyLevel.title: Honesty level
honestyLevel.description: W (launch/connect), R (runtime evidence collected), E (human judgment; assigned only by the maintainer, never auto-assigned). Assignment is sequential W -> R -> E.

risk.title: Claim risk
risk.description: Consequence if the claim is wrong; high-risk claims require the strongest evidence.

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: One bounded claim with the evidence that supports it, its risk, its honesty level, the exact wording allowed, and the condition under which it must be refused.

claimId.title: Claim identifier
claimId.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the bundle.

evidencePointer.title: Evidence pointer
evidencePointer.description: Bundle-relative path (and optional selector) to the artifact that supports the claim.

safeWording.title: Safe wording
safeWording.description: Single sentence that cannot overstate the evidence. The GATE3 block copies this wording verbatim.

refusalSite.title: Refusal site
refusalSite.description: Exact condition under which the claim must be refused (exit 21). The offline verifier tests its liveness.
